changeSet.author: openelis

preConditions.sqlCheck: select count(*) from clinlims.test where description = 'Cytology examination'
select count(*) from clinlims.test_section where name = 'Cytology'

changeSet.comment: Create the Cytology examination test (LOINC 33716-2) in the Cytology section

column.name: test_section_id
column.valueComputed: (select id from test_section where name = 'Cytology' limit 1)

column.name: name_localization_id
column.valueComputed: (select id from localization where description = 'cytology test name (028)' limit 1)

column.name: reporting_name_localization_id
column.valueComputed: (select id from localization where description = 'cytology test reporting name (028)' limit 1)

changeSet.author: openelis

changeSet.comment: Create default Cytology specimen TypeOfSample for program-order import

column.name: name_localization_id
column.valueComputed: (select id from localization where english = 'Cytology specimen' and description = 'sampleType name' limit 1)

changeSet.author: openelis

preConditions.sqlCheck: select count(*) from clinlims.test where description = 'Cytology examination'
select count(*) from clinlims.type_of_sample where description = 'Cytology specimen'
